subject: Request: Senior Pricing Authorization for OptimaHealth Hosted API Commitment
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: OptimaHealth - request for >20% hosted API concession (early view)

Naomi / team,

Quick summary up front: OptimaHealth (pilot customer converting to production) is asking for a 30% off list Hosted API usage rate for a 2-year committed plan tied to multi-region rollout and an aggressive usage ramp. They want contract start within 7 days.

Why they ask:
- Forecasted monthly token consumption starting 450M tokens, with 3x growth in 6 months (see attached forecast).
- Competitive pressure: two other vendors pitched deeper margins if we don't move quickly.
- Procurement pushing for consolidated billing across subsidiaries.

We ran preliminary margin math and this concession would push unit contribution below our standard mid-market threshold if taken without guardrails. Still, this is strategically valuable: OptimaHealth is a reference prospect for multi-region telehealth (US+EU) and they asked for Dedicated capacity assurances and a private SLA.

Proposed structured concession (recommended by Sales):
1) 30% discount off hosted usage list for 24 months conditioned on:
   - 24-month minimum committed spend: $1.2M ARR equivalent (tiered schedule in attached).
   - Upfront 60% of year-1 billed at signature or monthly prepay option with higher discount (opt-in).
   - Growth milestones with step-in price if monthly avg falls below thresholds.
2) Auto-escalation fallback: If utilization spikes beyond forecast, Redwood can switch to a higher-performance instance family with equivalent pricing protections for the term.
3) Security/Legal: OptimaHealth requires SOC2 evidence and a short list of privacy redlines (we can meet most, legal to confirm).

Attachments: OptimaHealth_SOW_draft.pdf, usage_forecast.xlsx

Ask: Need senior pricing authorization for a 30% concession or guidance to counter with a 25% cap + the guardrails above. Please advise ASAP — procurement wants a firm answer this week.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: OptimaHealth_SOW_draft.pdf]
[Attachment: usage_forecast.xlsx]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: OptimaHealth - request for >20% hosted API concession (early view)

Mina — forwarding the OptimaHealth ask. Ben's outlined the recommendation (30% for a 2-year commit with upfront). I've flagged the primary P&L impact in the attached finance calc: finance_impact_calc.csv.

My read: OptimaHealth is strategically attractive and likely to be a marquee multi-region reference, but 30% as an unrestricted list discount is too aggressive without explicit contractual guardrails. If we were to approve north of 20%, I want to see:
- firm minimum committed spend and enforceable milestones,
- payment terms (prepay vs. monthly),
- limits on ramp-stage credits (no retroactive credits that exceed quarter thresholds),
- an SLA addendum that waives premium credits if they use burst/dedicated capacity by prior notice.

Recommend: Executive approval for up to 28% provided Sales and Finance sign off on the final commitment schedule + Legal redlines the SOW to include the guardrails above. If you prefer, we can cap at 25% and add a one-time onboarding credit instead of a larger percent.

Attaching: finance_impact_calc.csv (quick model).

Thanks,
Naomi
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: finance_impact_calc.csv]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 15:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: OptimaHealth - request for >20% hosted API concession (early view)

Thanks for the quick brief and the model. I reviewed the finance calc and the strategic notes. My provisional position: I can authorize up to 28% off list on Hosted API usage for this opportunity under the following non-negotiable guardrails:

1) Committed minimum spend of at least $1.1M over 24 months with defined monthly floors.
2) 50–60% of year-1 commitment must be invoiced at signature (or a signed prepay addendum) — no more than two installment payments without escrow.
3) Include a price-protection clause tied to token-class changes and an explicit cap on aggregate credits (no retroactive token credits that exceed 10% of billed usage in a quarter).
4) SLA: specify response/availability targets; CS will provide an onboarding plan and resourcing commitment.
5) Legal to prepare limited redlines; Finance to confirm contribution margin threshold is acceptable given our cohort economics.

Grace/Marcus — coordinate legal and finance redlines. Ben — if Optima insists on 30% flat with no guardrails, push back and offer 28% + onboarding credit instead.

I'll approve once the final SOW + payment schedule reflect the guardrails above. If there's a compelling strategic rationale that requires 30% (market exclusivity, substantial co-marketing dollars, or a multi-year enterprise retainer >$3M), bring that explicitly to me with quantified ROI.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
VP, Global Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Alice Long <alice.long@optimahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@optimahealth.com
Cc: Terry Olson <terry.olson@optimahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Senior Pricing Authorization for OptimaHealth Hosted API Commitment

Ben / team,

Thank you — OptimaHealth is prepared to move quickly. We appreciate the flexibility and would like to lock in 30% as discussed on the call. Our procurement team will accept contractual guardrails if they are reasonable, but the headline rate needs to be 30% to get internal sign-off from the board.

Timeline: procurement would like a DocuSign packet this week (within 5 business days). Please send the agreement with the price schedule and SOW. We are happy to provide a short press quote and participate in a joint case study once the product is live.

Procurement contact: procurement@optimahealth.com
Legal contact: Terry Olson <terry.olson@optimahealth.com>

Best,
Alice Long
Head of Partnerships, OptimaHealth Inc.
[Forwarded attachment referenced: PO_template.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, procurement@optimahealth.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Senior Pricing Authorization for OptimaHealth Hosted API Commitment

Got it — pushing internal timeline. Next steps:
- Legal and Finance: I'll drop the SOW + the proposed payment schedule into the shared Drive folder and ask Legal to prepare a DocuSign packet with two pricing options: (A) 30% headline discount with the explicit guardrails Mina requested, and (B) 28% with a one-time onboarding credit (to preserve margin).
- CS: assign a named onboarding lead and produce an initial runbook before signature.
- HubSpot: updated deal record with deal id DEAL-OPT-4829 and attached forecast.

Related links: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/DEAL-OPT-4829 (record), https://docusign.example.com/transaction/abc123 (placeholder).

On quoting Alice:
> "We appreciate the flexibility and would like to lock in 30% as discussed on the call."

If we can get the guardrails in contract and at least 50% of year-1 invoiced at signature, I'm comfortable moving the packet to legal. I'll coordinate with Marcus on final contribution numbers.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: link to Drive folder with SOW and payment schedule]
